entries.hypothesis: One-step deviations within the consequential option set O(I), followed by D (greedy+R-mask), have meaningful headroom over D.
entries.input_contract: public observation/catalog define O(I); branch outcomes are labels only
entries.label_privilege: hidden-state (true-world clone) rollouts: optimistic non-deployable bound H; same-information estimate via regression Q-hat^D on public features
endpoints: H: E[max_a Q_true^D - Q_true^D(D)] per state and per episode (oracle one-step rollout policy)
fraction of states with any option > D by >=.01

next_branch.fail: bounded multi-step option class; if also < .02, stop Track A and report

entries.metric_checks: H is an upper bound by construction (max over realized branches), never a claim of deployable gain; per-option-type breakdown reported

entries.hypothesis: A cost-sensitive ranking head trained on Q^D branch targets improves deployed utility over D and over teacher-action supervision at matched label cost.
entries.intervention: rollout-based cost-sensitive policy improvement (RSPI-style; one optional iteration)
comparator: public heuristics (budget escalate, reuse-if-applicable, minimal revision)
entries.input_contract: frozen actor features + public telemetry; no hidden state/branch outcomes at inference
entries.label_privilege: simulator branching offline (charged); regression targets only; near-ties as equivalence sets
entries.selection_rule: margin m and fallback threshold registered on development states before screening
entries.promotion: screen (1 lineage, development-selected): utility >= D+.015, success >= D-.01, utility >= teacher-sup comparator + .01

next_branch.fail: inspect targets/option scope/features; no hyperparameter sweeps

entries.metric_checks: policy identical to D cannot pass; utility includes failures/abstentions; R-mask-scored metrics excluded from learned-choice claims

entries.hypothesis: The promoted improvement generalizes to fresh lineages and sealed worlds.
entries.intervention: A-PI recipe applied to bootstraps r3-r5
entries.selection_rule: final raw and development-selected policies both reported
entries.promotion: utility >= D + margin (margin fixed from A-PI development power analysis, default .01) in 3/3 lineages; success >= D-.01; per-condition floor >= .8 x dep_reuse success
entries.worlds: sealed fresh range registered at launch (>= 210M), 512 per condition

entries.hypothesis: The historical combination failure is localized to a specific stage (belief / value estimate / ranking / deployment).
entries.intervention: none (exact-label localization on existing models; oracle-belief diagnostic re-run)
entries.input_contract: existing L1/L4 models seeds 0-5, historical challenge pairs U+E, S+C (separately)
entries.label_privilege: exact DP labels and exact belief (diagnostic only)
entries.metric_checks: challenge sets are inspected data: localization only, no transfer claims

entries.training_support: all singles + remaining pairs except new holds (historical pairs only in exposure arm BX1)
entries.audit: split-support audit before any model run: labels function of visible info; held-out pairs never co-occur in training; configs disjoint by generator parameters

entries.hypothesis: Exposure (BX1) or supplied factorized public state incl. exact belief (BX2) fixes probing on unseen combinations.
intervention: B0 baseline L1 on new split
entries.input_contract: public only; BX2 features are a deterministic public computation, labelled supplied
entries.label_privilege: exact labels as training targets only
entries.selection_rule: final checkpoints; development split of training configurations
endpoints: uniquely-optimal probe rate on new holds (support)
entries.promotion: on new holds: probe_unique >= B0 + .15 in 3/3 seed pairs, not-optimal <= .10, regret <= B0 + 1.0 per episode (non-inferiority tolerance registered 2026-09-27 before any B-X run; ~1 SE of per-split regret in extended-04)
entries.statistics: CIs clustered by configuration; per-seed, per-family
entries.v2: split table probeworld-split-v2 (seeds 5.1e9-5.8e9); holds sized by exact solver (>=60 uniquely-optimal-first-probe configs; U+C >=20 flag-sensitive); B-HR gate on B0 first; arms B0/BX1/BX2/BX3 seeds 10-12; BO seeds 0-2 on ext-04 split (diagnostic)

entries.hypothesis: The promoted arm's gain replicates on fresh seeds and fresh configuration draws of the new holds.
entries.worlds: new configuration draws from the new-hold families (registered generator seed), not only new outcome draws
